j.osc1_pwm.init: Oscillator 1 is not on the square or narrow pulse wave, and pulse width only changes those. Switch its WAVEFORM to one of them.

j.mix1.mix.osc1=0: The OSCILLATOR 1 knob is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn it up.

j.mix2.init: The OSCILLATOR 2 knob is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn it up.

j.mix3.init: The NOISE knob is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn it up.

j.rev_in.rev.mix=0: Reverb MIX is at 0, so only the dry sound is heard, and that does not pass through here. Turn MIX up to hear what is patched in.
